g.text: Tutor-student management app for Egypt's private tutoring market, where tutors often manage 200+ students across WhatsApp and paper.
Group management, auto-graded quizzes, QR-based fee tracking, and a RAG-powered AI bot answering student questions from course materials.
FLUTTER · SUPABASE · GEMINI FLASH (RAG) · PRODUCT SCOPING — PAUSED TO FOCUS ON A NEW PRODUCT
Automated daily scanner that tracks hackathon and bootcamp announcements across Egyptian tech community Facebook pages.
Pipeline: scraper → deduplication → Arabic-typo-tolerant keyword matching → Telegram delivery. Grew to 60+ subscribers organically.
PYTHON · GITHUB ACTIONS · APIFY · TELEGRAM BOT API · ~$0.15/MONTH TO RUN
Open-source contribution: a Flutter controller app for Liquid Galaxy, a multi-screen Google Earth visualization system.
SSH-based orchestration of a master/slave display cluster, with dynamic KML generation for overlays and fly-to commands.
FLUTTER · DART · SSH · KML · DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS DEBUGGING
